summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist per the spec, uncommitted and untested (tests and black/flake8 were not run, per instructions). Changes: new monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with the loader and private _resolve_path helper; explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py; "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst; new tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Line lengths in the three new or changed Python files were measured and none exceed 120 columns. One addition beyond the spec: the loader raises ValueError if the entries under data_list_key are not a list. Remove that check if you want strict spec behavior.
